correctness.rationale: The exact min-norm residual-projection formula and Haar Gaussian beta decomposition yield the whole joint law. A sample-normalized Gaussian maximum differs in square by o_p(1) from the raw maximum, and chi-square ratio fluctuates by o_p(1) at the critical log scale, yielding the precise Gumbel constant. The independent positive-weights existence comparison follows from Wendel plus an interior-convex-hull perturbation. Rational checks verify the foundational identities, while analytical arguments, not simulations, establish infinite claims.

value.rationale: For constructive positive cubature, requiring every least-squares weight to be positive gives stable noncancelling integration. The sharp phase and Gumbel window provide parameter-level sample-complexity guidance and reveal a provable log-factor separation from the mere geometric existence of positive cubature on the same nodes.
